mapper.select: SELECT * FROM contest_users ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contest_users (user_id, selected_questions, current_question_id, total_score, submitted, start_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{selectedQuestions}, #{currentQuestionId}, #{totalScore}, #{submitted}, #{startTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE contest_users SET selected_questions = #{selectedQuestions}, current_question_id = #{currentQuestionId}, total_score = #{totalScore}, submitted = #{submitted}, start_time = #{startTime}, submit_time = #{submitTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE contest_users SET total_score = total_score + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
